The date for the Winklevoss Bitcoin ETF IPO (initial public offering) has not yet been determined.
The IPO date of the Winklevoss Bitcoin Trust (BATS: COIN) – the fund’s official name – can’t be set until the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) approves a rule change that will allow the ETF to begin trading. The deadline for that decision is March 11.
The rule change was filed by the BATS BZX Exchange. It’s needed because the Winklevoss Bitcoin ETF is based on a digital, not a physical, commodity. That sets it apart from previous commodity-based ETFs, such as the SPDR Gold Trust ETF (NYSE Arca:GLD).
If the SEC does approve the rule change, the Winklevoss Bitcoin Trust IPO would launch as soon as it could, likely within a matter of months. Top Gold Stocks To Buy Right Now: TD Ameritrade Holding Corporation(AMTD)
